title: Kalshi ditches Trump Jr. as advisor; CEO admitted "optics" weren't good
summary: Trump son advised Kalshi and got equity while Trump admin helped Kalshi in lawsuits.
llm_summary: Kalshi, a regulated exchange for event‑based contracts, has removed Donald Trump Jr. from its advisory board after its CEO said the “optics” of the relationship were problematic. The former advisor had been compensated with equity, and the firm previously benefited from favorable actions
